newsitem.title: MALTA: Israeli, Palestinian ministers to meet in Malta.
newsitem.headline: Israeli, Palestinian ministers to meet in Malta.

text.p: Israeli and Palestinian ministers will meet in Malta on the sidelines of a European-Mediterranean conference, Palestinian Planning Minister Nabil Shaath said on Tuesday.
Shaath said he would meet Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy but no time had been fixed. Levy was to arrive on Tuesday for the two-day conference on the Mediterranean island.
It will be the first time Israelis and Palestinians have met at this level since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered work to start on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"There will be a meeting but not with (Palestinian President Yasser) Arafat," Shaath told Reuters. Asked if Shaath himself would be meeting Levy, he said: "Yes."
The Europeans at the Malta conference have been pressing for an Israeli-Palestinian meeting in the hope of resuming Middle East peace talks.
